explication: Plane Radar is ESP32 firmware whose principal workflow is to configure or reconnect Wi-Fi, load a saved radar center and range, periodically fetch nearby ADS-B traffic, and render it on a round display. The main loop coordinates these stages; the radar view combines aircraft symbols, scale/grid, and optional runway overlays. The README documents portal controls, persistent preferences, reconnect behavior, and runway data capabilities. Several subsystem details are supported by the README and tree but were not sampled, so their internal wiring is shown only where documented.
